title: Chapter 122 Returning To The Teacher To Suppress The Rebellion
content:
Chapter 122 Returning To The Teacher To Suppress The Rebellion

With the complete departure of the white-robed man in front of him, the entire plain once again fell into a deathly silence, and no one spoke for a long time.

Within these short hours, less than a day. Zhong Yu and his battalion of soldiers, as well as the barbarians on the opposite plain, experienced a battle of gods that made them dizzy and never encountered once in a lifetime.

One after another, the gods who were originally aloof, are now like ordinary mortals, losing their lives as easily as ants in the face of such unimaginable battles.

It is even worse than the performance of mortals on the battlefield. At least no one will deliberately target some soldiers, but those gods are different. They are deliberately taken care of by countless people, and it is difficult to escape if they want to escape.

After a long time, Zhong Yu, who came back to his senses, was the first to start his action.

Before the barbarians on the opposite side recovered from the shock of the death of all their gods and the fall of many gods, they immediately ordered to integrate the army.

Taking advantage of this heaven-sent opportunity, he planned to destroy the barbarians who had no will to fight in one fell swoop, so that they would not have to go through a lot of trouble after they regained their fighting will.

"attack!"

With the busyness of the army, relying on their strict discipline and rich experience, they reorganized an offensive formation in a short while, and under Zhong Yu's order, they attacked the city row by row.

It was another brutal fight. All the barbarians resisted for a while because of the death of their gods and the strength of the enemy who had just shown their might. They resisted for a while, and surrendered after a while.

With the surrender of the entire Edel tribe, the entire Edel Alliance no longer has any resistance.

What I need to do now is to return to Luoyang City. There is still a traitor there, waiting for him to deal with it.

My foundation in this world is in Luoyang City. Even if Luoyang City is lost, it will not cause any fundamental harm to me, but at least there will be more troubles.

What's more, I hate people like traitors the most. Sun Jian himself treats him well. A 50,000-strong army of the Southwest Route Army was handed over to him. of.

But he didn't want to repay his favor. Instead, he conspired behind his back to want to rebel, which betrayed his trust in him. Most importantly, he mocked his own strategy. Are you laughing at me for not knowing who I employ?

However, this incident also reminded me that my previous oppression of the generals of the Three Kingdoms was really too strong, especially for destroying their world.

For the Chinese who have a strong affection for their homeland, they must pay attention to returning to their roots and falling leaves in everything. I have destroyed the places where they will rest in the soil in the future. It is not surprising that they hate themselves so much.

It seems that I will be more gentle in my actions in the future. Some of these civil servants and military generals from the Three Kingdoms are not very useful anymore, and they must be selectively excluded.

But fortunately, my own development will definitely be absolutely fast in the future, and these people born in the Three Kingdoms will not be able to keep up with my own progress. They will also be slowly eliminated by themselves and become the bottom people in the empire.

What's more, Zhong Yu still has one of the most amazing coups, don't those people want to practice inner skills? Want to hit the road of otherworldliness?

Thinking of the information his spy got from Sun Jian, he got a few barbarian fighting qi cultivation skills, and saw that he was a little bit disadvantaged.

Ambition arose in their hearts, and they dared to take actions to resist themselves. I really didn't expect that these fighting qi exercises would be so tempting to them.

But then again, if it were me, I'm afraid it would be difficult to resist this temptation, it's just human nature.

However, if the object of the rebellion is replaced by himself, then it cannot be tolerated, and must be dealt with thoroughly, and he will be given the most painful price to warn future generations not to offend.

Now, Zhong Yu's army has undergone repeated battles, and its strength has been severely damaged. Now there are only 120,000 people left.

20,000 people are left here to defend against the attacks of the other two alliances, but they probably don't have much energy to take care of themselves now.

All the gods they enshrined fell at this moment, and their priests should have gotten the news, and they each notified the principals of their own forces.

Hearing this shocking news all of a sudden, if you don't get frightened, you're too busy, and you still have to think about calming down the turbulent undercurrent in the country, so how can you have time to send troops to expand!

Therefore, letting Cao Cao lead 20,000 people to stay here, it seems that Cao Cao's loyalty to himself is still guaranteed to a certain extent.

Cao Cao, who is most knowledgeable about current affairs and cunning, did not even completely fall into a desperate situation before his own strength kept suppressing him. It seemed that he would never betray himself, even if he faced death.

The problem of defending against foreign enemies in the northwest and taking back other tribes was all handed over to Cao Cao. As for him, he personally led the remaining 100,000 troops and rushed back to Luoyang City, preparing to suppress the rebel army in the middle and stabilize his rear.

The 100,000-strong army marched quickly. Although Zhong Yu wanted to hurry to Luoyang, the 100,000-strong army could not just leave at will. Delays are normal.

Therefore, even though he had speeded up as much as possible, it was already ten days later when he actually arrived at Luoyang City.

At this time, after returning to Luoyang City, he received the first information. However, Pingyin City is still in his hands, but it is already crumbling, and there are only more than 1,000 people stationed in the whole city.

However, Sun Jian's army who attacked the city was not very happy. Since his rebellion, he has been running around non-stop for a day, and his army has been attacking the city.

At this moment, under the insistence of Tian Feng, Zhang Liao and others, they are fighting with Pingyin City. The army of more than 30,000 people that had just been brought here now only has more than 10,000 people. Among them, there are many old, weak, sick and disabled, and the army is full of mourning.

Now Sun Jian wants to force these people under him to attack, and the flat in front of him is gloomy. The people under him are also unwilling, and have initiated many instances of disobedience.

Sun Jian placed the strings of heads on the barracks flag. It is telling how many of these soldiers are disobeying orders.

Now there is an undercurrent surging in the barracks, which may erupt at any time, and it may not be necessary to finally do it yourself. In the next few days when this kind of situation of not caring about the lives of our soldiers and storming the city happens again, the camp roar will be inevitable. will happen.

Three days later, His Majesty the Emperor of the Great Yu Kingdom, the former master of Sun Jian's rebel army. Zhong Yu has defeated many enemy gods and led an army of 100,000 back to aid. Be ready to send troops at any time to pacify these rebels. The news spread to Sun Jian's camp.

There was an uproar in the entire military camp. The reason why these soldiers were willing to rebel with Sun Jian was not because they had seen before, the invincible power of those gods.

The extraordinary strength and resistance far beyond the imagination of ordinary people deeply shocked their ignorant and weak hearts.

That's why, under the circumstances of resigning to fate, he rebelled with Sun Jian in a broken pot, just because he was afraid of confronting those gods head-on, and wanted to seek a way out under the hands of the gods?
